_about: Per-image caption overrides for caption.py, keyed by filename stem (the dataset file's or its source's). 'tags' are added as variable tags; 'replace': true uses only them (no shot/outfit/scene tags); 'form' and 'shot' override curate.py's. Never put locked canon tags or the trigger here: caption.py adds those. Put dataset-specific overrides in DATASET/overrides.json; they win over this file.
